owner_creation.analysis: LOG_FAILED: The AtomicBool owns a sticky log-output failure bit initialized false; it owns neither logfile nor namelogfile.
owner_creation.invariant: The failure latch contains no resource pointer.
limitations: Only this failure latch is clear; M0-IO-004 and raw file/log ownership remain separate open obligations.

aliases_escapes.analysis: LOG_FAILED: logfile_failed returns a copied Boolean; record_log_failure uses swap without exposing an address or borrowing input-buffer bytes.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Observers receive values rather than mutable aliases.
limitations: Only this failure latch is clear; M0-IO-004 and raw file/log ownership remain separate open obligations.

callback_targets.analysis: LOG_FAILED: The first transition calls io_error_diagnostic directly with a static byte string; the flag cannot store a logging callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Failure reporting does not retain a callback context.
limitations: Only this failure latch is clear; M0-IO-004 and raw file/log ownership remain separate open obligations.

invalidation.analysis: LOG_FAILED: The bit is never reset in maintained code, so later buffer/file replacement cannot invalidate the previously recorded failure.
invalidation.invariant: A logged failure remains sticky until process exit.
limitations: Only this failure latch is clear; M0-IO-004 and raw file/log ownership remain separate open obligations.

mutation_commit.analysis: LOG_FAILED: swap(true) precedes the diagnostic; Relaxed is sufficient because the latch does not publish any accompanying owned payload.

limitations: Only this failure latch is clear; M0-IO-004 and raw file/log ownership remain separate open obligations.

limitations: Only this failure latch is clear; M0-IO-004 and raw file/log ownership remain separate open obligations.
